record.title: Use the same six-leaf population for terrain effective-hours aggregation
record.contract_trace: terrain_skill_rows constructs six distinct Skill terrain entries (Plains, Forest, Hills, Wetlands, Urban, Snow), averages their direct hours over6, but averages the corresponding effective_skill_hours sum over5. The summary rank helper also averages six ranks over6. SkillTooltip::aggregate receives these mismatched averages, derives correlated_hours=effective-trained, and emits accessible description plus serialized tooltip JSON. For a legitimate forest1000h and other direct0 state, symmetric20% correlations produce six effective amounts summing2000h: the aggregate reports400 effective hours instead of333.3, inflating implied correlated contribution. Existing terrain fixture asserts an individual200h leaf and has no isolated aggregate check; it does not close this discrepancy.

Remove independently hard-coded aggregate divisors; do not change six-leaf20% transfer, leaf ranks, direct-zero policy or the rank average. Repair this actual shared family projection once rather than local duplicate terrain definitions.
